senses.gloss: गव- + अमृत गव- + अमृत, n. अमृत, consisting of rays, MBh. 3, 17351.
गव- + अश्व गव- + अश्व, n. bulls and horses, MBh. 1, 3654.
गव- + आह्निक गव- + आह्निक, n. the daily food of a cow, MBh. 13, 6175.

गव गव, i. e. गो + अ, a substitute for गो in comp. words, e. g. गवार्ह, i. e. गव-अर्ह, adj. Worth a bull, MBh. 2, 828. गवार्थे, i. e. गव-अर्थे, adv. For preserving a cow, Man. 10, 69. अष्टगव, i. e. अष्टन्-, adj. Drawn by eight oxen, MBh. 8, 799. स्त्री-गवी, f. a milch cow.

गवय गवय (akin to गो), m.
 1. A species of ox, Bos gavæus, Pañc. 53, 10. []
 2. The name of a monkey, Rām. 4, 25, 33.

गवाक्ष गवाक्ष, i. e. गव-अक्ष, m.
 1. An air-hole, a round window, a bull's eye, Rām. 3, 61, 13.
 2. (m. ?) The name of a sea, Rājat. 5, 423.
 3. The name of a monkey, Rām. 4, 25, 33.

गविष्ठ गविष्ठ, m.
 1. The sun, Bhāg. P. 1, 10, 36.
 2. The name of a Dānava, MBh. 1, 2538.
गवेष् गवेष्, i. e. गव-इष्, i. 1, Ātm.; i. 10, Par. To search, Ṛt. 1, 21; Kathās. 24, 230.
गवेषण गवेषण, i. e. गवेष् + अन, n. Search, Kathās. 21, 85.
गवेषिन् गवेष् + इन्, adj. Searching, MBh. 3, 10890.

गव्य गव्य, i. e. गो + य,
 I. adj., f. या,
 1. Produced by a cow.
 2. Consisting of milk.
 II. n. Milk.
 --Comp.

गव्यूति गव्यूति, i. e. गो-यु + ति, f.
 1. Pasture-ground (ved.).
 2. A measure = 4000 daṇḍa = 2 krośas, Rām. 6, 33, 13.
